Consecutive green Windows sweeps (cluster A4, session 3d705fec):
1. run 44606030731, `sweep (windows)` job 135849846469, main a28027d5ec7, `success` (20,269 passed, 872 skipped, 0 failed).
2. run 44621093373, job 135902646205, main 0fec72331c4, `success` (20,269 passed, 872 skipped, 0 failed).
None of the 14 lines removed from `file-locks.args` (035b7371de8) is in an active deselect file. None failed in either job.
Third: run 44636174645 (main 8c6c4f29af8, dispatched by another session) is queued; it will be #3 if it concludes success.

Needs an operator decision before close: 1 of the 14 lines, `tests/unit/test_detached_child_cwd.py::test_durable_cwd_never_raises_when_the_callers_own_directory_is_gone`, is decorated `skipif(os.name == "nt")` by this ticket's own commit 035b7371de8 ("Windows refuses to delete a directory that is a process's cwd"). So it skips, never passes, on Windows. The criterion says "names a test that passed", with no skip allowance, so as worded it cannot be met for this 1 line. The other 13 have no Windows skip construct. Options:
(1) Accept a platform-reasoned skip for this 1 test, amend the criterion to "passed or skipped with a stated platform reason", and close as env_integration after sweep 3.
(2) Give the test a Windows-meaningful variant that passes there (a cwd-gone state Windows can reach), then count 3 fresh sweeps.
